findings.title: 'AI process never spawned' assertion is tautological
findings.evidence: tools/replay.py run(): the sim_only asserts check an args list built two lines earlier from constants (always ends in sim/ship.ail); 'AI service launches=0' is a hard-coded print. Nothing observes real child processes; run() has no other launch site.
findings.proposed_fix: Count actual spawned argv via a wrapper/popen hook (or inspect the child's ai_request replies being unanswered) and print the measured count; or soften the claim to 'by construction'.

findings.title: codexUnlocks prefix, table-hint and hints-equality branches have no failing test
findings.evidence: Mutations removing the prefix() check and removing 'c.hints == hints' left session-audit-test green (exit 0); removing tableOk left codex-unlocks green on the real stream. Only ids order/completeness and one hint inference are covered by fixtures. holds(h,c1) is true by construction since hs derive from the same flags, so it adds no check.
findings.proposed_fix: Add fixtures: early unlock (I confirmed by hand that two-clocks unlocked before commit yields FAIL, but it is not a committed test), a shrinking cumulative list, and a new_game archive table with a wrong 'unlock' hint.
